name: StepFlow
description: A stepped-flow ENGINE (useStepFlow + StepFlow* slot primitives) that wears the design's own markup — panels, answer cards, counter words, whichever nav the frame draws — plus a styled StepFlow wrapper for designs that drew no flow UI of their own.
whenToUse: Designs that walk the reader through a SEQUENCE one panel at a time. Author the frame's OWN markup and drive it with useStepFlow + the primitives: StepFlowPanel per step, StepFlowOption asChild makes the design's card the whole answer control (real radio underneath), StepFlowProgress is a render prop over the design's own counter words, StepFlowBack/StepFlowNext exist only where the frame draws them — and when no Next is mounted, picking an answer IS the advance (after a beat that shows the verdict). StepFlowResult is the ending: the author's markup over { score, answers, restart }, or mount a native form inside it (with StepFlowAnswerFields) and the ending is a capture per the host's form contract. The styled StepFlow component is the fallback for a design that drew no quiz/stepper UI at all — never the thing to reshape a designed section around. NOT for panels the reader opens in any order (Accordion or Tabs) or a horizontal gallery (Carousel).

implements.note: Author the frame's markup and wire useStepFlow (mode 'stepper') + primitives into it; the design decides which nav exists (reachability: with no Next drawn, advancing is the reader's own gesture). Use the styled StepFlow only when the design drew no flow UI.

Author the frame's markup: StepFlowOption asChild makes the design's answer cards the controls, verdicts arrive as data-state='correct|wrong', no Next mounted means answering advances after the verdict beat. The ending is a decision — plain result, or a capture form (StepFlowAnswerFields carries the answers) per the host's form contract.
